data.name: Wooden Fist
data.description: As a free action, your hands can become as hard as wood, covered in tiny thorns. While you have wooden fists, your unarmed strikes do not provoke attacks of opportunity, deal lethal damage, and gain a +%1 bonus on damage rolls. You can use this ability for %2 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|max(DomainPlantLVL/2,1)|WoodenFistRounds
